correctness.rationale: Complete enumeration of all 2^16 vertex masks using acyclic+degree<=2 predicates yields the two explicit face vectors; independently reconstructed both graphs and full original-chain GF(2) ranks. In F2(S), the verified source constructs acyclic 2934-pair matching (29024 Hasse incidences), critical cells (22,19,36), and integral Morse boundary d5 with twelve unit Smith factors and one 2; d6=0. This gives H4=Z^9+Z/2,H5=Z^6,H6=Z^36. Rook matching 3204 pairs has (4,37,72) critical and four unit d5 factors, d6=0, so H5=Z^33,H6=Z^72. Independent binary Betti ranks S (10,7,36), R (33,72) agree with universal coefficients. Characteristic-two checks are only corroboration; exact torsion relies on the signed Morse-Smith source calculation.
residual_risks: Source integral Smith and full Morse acyclicity code inspected; full expensive double-order Morse computation not independently rerun. No homotopy claim for S.
